messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for elevated error rate on /v1/stream (hosted-prod-us-west-2). Error threshold breached: 4.8% over 90s. War room: https://warroom.redwood.internal/rooms/INC-1768899999

emma_k: oncall here, acknowledging pager. joining war room now. paging ops_lead and rajiv_t.

rajiv_t: oncall eng-runtime, joining. grabbing recent deploy diffs and perf metrics. any customer reports yet?

claire: I see increased 5xx from streaming lanes tied to batch_size>64 worker shards. Affected orgs: 5041, 9012. Also seeing gptq quant mismatch warnings after last quant rollout.

ops_lead: assigning owners: emma_k -> incident lead & customer comms; rajiv_t -> technical triage; dan_s -> infra rollback & routing. Claire, stay on logs.

emma_k: taking it. first mitigation: reduce max_batch_size for streaming lane, failover streaming traffic to smaller-shard pool, and apply model-variant fallback if errors persist.

dan_s: preparing routing changes. target fallback model: redwood-mistral-7b-fp16. Pools to route: pool-17a -> pool-0c-fallback. running dry-run then canary.

rajiv_t: looking at runtime traces. snippet of recent logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:05:12Z warn: quantizer: mismatched_shard_layout for model redwood-mistral-7b-quant
2026-03-15T12:05:14Z error: stream_handler: failed_write 502, batch_id=98532
2026-03-15T12:05:14Z info: batch_scheduler: active_batches=18, avg_latency_ms=420
```

claire: yep kernel/quant dispatch changed in last midnight deploy. that likely exposed a layout incompatibility for large shards.

emma_k: dan, please start canary routing to fallback and throttle batch_size to 32 for streaming lanes. I'll draft status page and targeted customer note.

dan_s: commands I'm running:
```
# reduce batch size cap for streaming queue
./configctl set queues/streaming/max_batch_size 32 --env=prod-us-west-2
# route 10% traffic of pool-17a to fallback pool
./infractl routing set pool-17a --split=90:10 --targets=pool-17a,pool-0c-fallback
```

incident-bot: Pager #5041-support notified. Acknowledged by becky_h at 1768899995. Incident timeline recorded.

becky_h: support here, standing by to send targeted notifications to org admins once we have confirmed mitigation steps.

emma_k: status page copy draft:
"
- Incident start: 12:05 UTC
- Impact: Partial service degradation for streaming text generation in US-WEST-2, primarily affecting large-shard/large-batch streaming sessions. Some requests may experience errors or elevated latency.
- Scope: Subset of customers with large-shard streaming workloads (orgs: 5041, 9012).
- Mitigation: Throttling max batch size, routing a portion of traffic to a fallback model variant, and investigating quantizer/kernel dispatch changes.
- Next update: in 20 minutes or upon significant change.
"

emma_k: add contact support@redwood.ai and an explicit line: "If you are experiencing ongoing failures, reply to this message or open a ticket." rajiv, please include ETA for recovery if you have one.

rajiv_t: tentative ETA 25-45m once canary shows stable KV-hit and error rates decline. i'll update when canary metrics look good. initial canary results expected in ~10 minutes.

claire: I'm collecting correlation traces and will attach relevant trace ids to the war room. also capturing failed payload samples for repro.

dan_s: canary started: 10% traffic to pool-0c-fallback. early metrics: canary error rate 0.4%, main pool still at 3.9%. routing change command and logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:09:02Z info: routing:update pool-17a split=90/10 target=pool-0c-fallback
2026-03-15T12:09:05Z info: canary: traffic=120r/min sample=10%
```

incident-bot: Note: oncall handoff reminder in 40m. If incident persists, please coordinate extended handoff.

emma_k: good. becky, craft a concise customer notification template with ETA and mitigation steps. keep it org-specific.

becky_h: template below, will personalize and send to admins of 5041 and 9012 once you ack.

Customer notification template:
"
Hi <Org Admin>,

We detected a partial degradation affecting long streaming sessions in the US-WEST-2 region. Mitigation actions (batch throttling and partial traffic failover to a fallback model) are in progress. We estimate an initial recovery within 255 minutes. If you continue to see errors, please reply or file a ticket at support@redwood.ai.

Thanks for your patience,
Emma (Redwood Oncall)
"

rajiv_t: monitoring canary dashboards. KV-cache hit looks restored for canary traces; errors down to 0.5% in canary. Sampling more traces to ensure no silent regressions.

dan_s: preparing rollback playbook for kernel/quant dispatch if fallback stable but main pool still degraded; will document commands in the war room.

emma_k: samantha not in thread, but ops_lead, please note we should publish this to status page now and mark incident as "partial degradation: mitigation in progress". I'll send targeted emails after we confirm canary holds for 10 minutes.

ops_lead: go ahead and publish. dan, rajiv, leave logs and commands in the war room for postmortem. we'll assign postmortem to eng-runtime (owner: rajiv_t) and eng-ml (owner: claire).

incident-bot: Status entry created on status.redwood.ai for INC-1768899999 at 1768899999.

becky_h: sending targeted notifications to org admins now. message queue shows delivery pending for 2 admins.

rajiv_t: canary stable at 15 minutes: error rate baseline 0.6% on canary, main pool error rate reduced to 1.1% after further throttles. moving to broaden routing to 30% fallback progressively.

dan_s: applying next routing step to 30% fallback: command executed. monitoring loop engaged.

emma_k: holding for 20 minutes of stability, then we'll begin debrief and close war room if no regressions. postmortem set and owner assigned. great job.

ops_lead: reminder: add remediation tasks for quantizer compatibility tests in CI and a pre-deploy check for large-shard batch behavior. :white_check_mark:
